reviews.title: Jestem zawiedziona
reviews.text:
Jestem bardzo rozczarowana tą grą. Miałam na starym telefonie kupione rzeczy, własne postacie i mnóstwo domków, które sama urządziłam. Kiedy zmieniłam telefon z Androida na iPhone’a, moje zakupy i zapisane rzeczy nie pojawiły się na nowym urządzeniu. Próbowałam użyć opcji „Przywróć zakupy”, ale mimo komunikatu „Świetnie, wszystko gotowe!” nic się nie zmieniło.

Rozumiem, że Android i iOS to różne systemy, ale uważam, że użytkownicy powinni mieć jasną informację o tym, co można przenieść, a co może zostać utracone. Szkoda, że nie ma prostego sposobu na przeniesienie zakupów, postaci i własnych domków. Włożyłam w tę grę dużo czasu i pieniędzy, a teraz nie mogę odzyskać tego, co miałam.

Mam nadzieję, że twórcy poprawią system przenoszenia danych i przywracania zakupów, ponieważ taka sytuacja naprawdę zniechęca do dalszego korzystania z gry.

reviews.title: Unlock all the world
reviews.text: I really wish all the worlds in Toca Boca World could be unlocked for everyone. A lot of players just want to enjoy the game fully, explore new places, create stories, decorate houses, and have fun without feeling limited. Some people can’t buy every pack or location, especially younger players, so having more free worlds would make the game feel more exciting and fair for everyone. Toca Boca is all about creativity and imagination, and unlocking more areas could help players express themselves even more, make better roleplays, and enjoy the game with friends. Even if not everything becomes free, adding more unlocked places or special events would make many fans really happy.

reviews.title: Predatory scam, avoid at all costs! upsell, no family cloud, no restore, invisible in apple purchase
reviews.text: Absolute trash and a predatory scammy game. The entire business model is based on aggressive upselling to kids. They deliberately disabled Apple Family Sharing for in-app purchases, forcing parents to buy the exact same content multiple times. Restoring purchases is a complete nightmare – the game forces an adult to "play" this garbage for 10 minutes through unskippable tutorials, only to realize the restore button is still invisible or broken! What's worse, they somehow manage to hide their transactions from Apple's standard App Store history. They do this on purpose so parents can't easily track or see how much money they’ve actually wasted on this trash. Getting in touch with Customer Care is near impossible. I’ve already spent way too much money on this app, but no more. I told my kids I won't buy another thing here – if they don't like it, they can stop playing or switch to "Avatar World". I refuse to support this blatant exploitation of parents through their kids. Pure cash grab. 1 star is being generous.
